brief: A telecom operator wants a web portal to track about 300 of its service vans in real time. Dispatchers need a live map, alerts when a van deviates from its route or sits idle, driver management and weekly KPI reports. Vehicle data comes from two telematics vendors.

A neobank needs a customer onboarding flow: document capture, identity verification through a third-party vendor, sanctions and PEP screening, and a console where compliance officers review flagged applications. Everything must be auditable and GDPR compliant.

A building materials wholesaler wants an online B2B marketplace. Suppliers upload catalogues in CSV and XML, buyers get customer-specific price lists, request quotes and pay online, and suppliers receive split payouts. Product pages must rank well in search engines.

A dental clinic chain wants a mobile app for patients to book appointments, join video consultations with dentists and receive reminders, plus a web dashboard for the clinics. Patient data must be handled in line with HIPAA.

A law firm wants a chat assistant that answers lawyers' questions using about 800 internal memos and precedents, shows which documents each answer came from, and only uses documents the asking lawyer is allowed to access. Web UI in Angular, SSO login.

A B2B SaaS company wants to give its customers an embedded analytics module: configurable dashboards with drag and drop widgets, near real-time metrics from a high volume event stream, scheduled email reports and PDF export, with strict tenant isolation.

The training department of a bank needs a learning management system: courses with video, quizzes with attempt limits, learning paths with enrolment rules, completion certificates, manager reports and import of SCORM packages from external vendors.

An HVAC maintenance company needs a mobile app for technicians that works in basements without signal: job lists, checklists, photos, customer signatures, automatic sync later, and integration with their ERP for jobs and spare parts. Back-office staff need a scheduling console.

An insurance company wants a claims intake portal: customers upload documents and photos, identity is verified through a vendor, a rules engine scores fraud risk and adjusters work through a review queue. Every decision needs an audit trail and personal data must be encrypted.

A pharmaceutical distributor wants an ordering marketplace for pharmacies with a large product catalogue fed by supplier data files, faceted search, negotiated prices per pharmacy, checkout with online payments and a supplier portal for stock and orders.

A delivery startup needs a courier mobile app that works offline, captures proof of delivery photos and signatures and syncs later, plus a dispatcher web console with live courier positions on a map and delay alerts.

A university wants an online learning platform with video courses, quizzes and certificates, and an AI tutor chatbot that answers student questions from the course materials and cites the lecture or page it used.

A mid-size company wants an HR portal for onboarding checklists, performance review cycles and document signing, with an AI assistant that answers employee questions about HR policies using the policy documents.

A diagnostic laboratory wants a patient portal where people view test results, book sample collection, and message the lab securely. Results come from the lab information system through an HL7 FHIR interface.

A fintech startup wants an expense management product for small businesses: bank feed integration, spending analytics dashboards, role-based approval workflows and monthly accounting exports. Financial data must be encrypted and every approval audited.

A retail chain wants a store operations app for staff: daily task lists, checklists with photo reporting, usable offline in warehouses, with a head-office dashboard showing completion rates per store.

A restaurant chain needs a marketing website in four languages with about 20 pages, a menu section, location pages with opening hours, a table reservation form and a CMS so the marketing team can edit content.
A company needs a small internal web tool where employees can swap work shifts with colleagues, managers approve or reject the swaps, and everyone gets notified in Slack. Around 300 employees.

A manufacturer wants a computer vision system that detects surface defects on products moving along a conveyor, using edge cameras on the line, a model training pipeline, an operator screen showing detections and a cloud dashboard for quality statistics.
A concert promoter wants an event ticketing platform with interactive seat maps, a fair virtual queue for high-demand on-sales, payments, mobile tickets with QR codes and a venue entry scanning app.
